body: Sometimes when page is refreshed, or when menu items are click the matrix rain scales up too much. Also we need to have a option to configure the background animation, on the bottom of the website we should have a link to settings page, where we should be able to configure all animation, so I can choose better default settings by trying them out. Make sure everything that can be configured is configurable and preview is instant (in the background of the same page) and settings are presaved in local storage if user wants some customization of the website. We also need configuration of UI skins, we can expand on apple glass with liquid glass like UI (it should be lots of configuration). And also add style similar to https://github.com/konard/immortality for futuristic angular like UI style, also with lots of configurations. In `Every configuration of 1–4 links` we should add options with `Show only real references`, where we exclude all combinations with 0, and keep only real links references, so they only reference real ones (each other or self). But the default should stay the same. Associative tech stack should be carefully expanded with all projects we have in the stack across repositories in linksplatform, link-foundation and link-assistant. It also should start from the meta theory of link-foundation. Also L -> L^2 should be configurable to R -> R^2 and so on, as per latest links meta theory draft, default at the moment is L -> L^2 per previous english draft.
title: Fixes and UI/UX improvements
